title: Quantitative critical homogenization of a three-dimensional non-homogeneous thermoviscous fluid in perforated domains
summary: In this paper, we consider a three-dimensional non-homogeneous incompressible fluid in a bounded periodically perforated domain at the critical Stokes-capacity scale. The density obeys a transport equation. The viscosity depends on a quasi-static temperature perturbation, which solves a uniformly elliptic transmission problem with insulated outer boundary conditions and zero spatial mean. The limiting momentum equation contains a Brinkman resistance term generated by the critical perforation regime.
